subject: [DEMO] Booking website for our bakery, budget $4,000
body: Hi, I run Puddleford Demo Bakery. We need a website with online cake orders before our spring launch on March 1. Our budget is $4,000. Can you send a quote and a start date?

subject: [DEMO] Need a CRM integration in two weeks
body: Hello, I am the operations lead at Brackwater Demo Logistics. We want to hire someone to connect our web form to our CRM and send alerts to the sales team. We need it live within two weeks. When can we have a call?

subject: [DEMO] Ready to start: monthly automation retainer
body: We are Lumberbottom Demo Studio. We have approved EUR 1,500 per month for automation work, starting next Monday. Please send your contract so we can sign this week.

subject: [DEMO] Just curious about automation
body: Hi there, I keep hearing about workflow automation. I am not sure yet if it fits my small shop. Do you have any general information I could read?

subject: [DEMO] Comparing options for next year
body: Hello, we are researching options for next year and comparing a few agencies. No budget yet. Could you tell me roughly what kind of projects you usually do?

subject: [DEMO] Question about your services
body: Hey, a friend mentioned you. Maybe at some point we would want something like a chatbot, but nothing is decided. Just saying hello for now.

subject: [DEMO] Cannot log in to the dashboard
body: Hi, since yesterday I cannot log in to the dashboard you built for us. It says my password is wrong, but the reset email never arrives. Can you help?

subject: [DEMO] Invoice address needs updating
body: Hello, our company moved offices. Could you update the billing address on our next invoice? The new address is 12 Demo Lane, Sampletown.

subject: [DEMO] Weekly report email stopped
body: Hi team, the weekly report email from the automation you set up stopped arriving two weeks ago. Nothing changed on our side. Could you take a look?

subject: [DEMO] Guaranteed page one ranking in 7 days!!!
body: Dear website owner, we guarantee page one ranking in 7 days. Buy 10,000 backlinks today for only $49. Reply YES to claim this limited offer.

subject: [DEMO] You have won a demo prize, confirm your bank details
body: Congratulations! You were selected as a winner. To receive your prize, reply with your bank account number and password within 24 hours.
